excerpt: Meltano is pip-installable and comes in a prepackaged docker container, you can have your first ELT pipeline running within minutes.
Initialize a new project in a directory of your choosing using meltano init
Add the GitHub extractor ... meltano add tap-github
Build your own Meltano connector to move data from any source to any destination.
Access to 600+ built-in connectors
Transformations in Meltano are implemented using dbt.
Meltano supports scheduled pipelines that can be orchestrated using Apache Airflow.
you can easily add the appropriate Dockerfile and .dockerignore files to your project by adding the docker file bundle
its configuration can be tested using meltano config test <plugin>
Meltano can handle catalog generation for you, by letting you describe your desired modifications using stream selection
If you already have an existing dbt project that you'd like to migrate to Meltano, check out the existing dbt project guide
If you're on Fivetran, use our savings estimator tool to see how much you can save with Meltano!
Built-in pipeline monitoring and alerts
Reverse ETL included
Initialize a new project in a directory of your choosing using `meltano init`
An extractor is responsible for pulling data out of any data source.
your project and pipelines are composed of plugins of different types, most notably extractors, loaders, utilities
you can treat it like any other software development project and benefit from DataOps best practices such as version control, code review, and continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD)
makes it easy to select which streams and properties to extract
keeps track of the incremental replication state, so that subsequent pipeline runs with the same state ID will always pick up right where the previous run left off
You host and manage everything on your own servers
Meltano hosts, scales, and maintains everything for you

Your data bill shouldn't keep growing.  
Pay for compute. Not rows.
`meltano add` lets you add or update [plugins](/concepts/plugins#project-plugins) in your Meltano project. The command is idempotent
Run all pipelines in one place, across databases, files, SaaS tools, internal systems, and workflows like dbt.
Build, adjust, and debug connectors directly. You are not blocked by ticket queues
Meltano and Pipelinewise are open source projects... you can just start playing with it and change the code, but there's no support to pay for.
The GitLab Data Team is running Meltano in production. We're currently extracting Zoom data with it and have plans for several more extractors (Slack, GMail, PTO by Roots, EdCast, and a few more).
before I try yet another ETL tool... I guess then it doesn't offer anything extra for us as we have already the ETL Platform self made and we add the process with just an extra file.
read through the homepage and not sure what value add this has over airflow? i must be completely misinterpreting the software.
That doesn't tell me what Meltano is... I hadn't seen the term DataOps before, despite working in this area... what you've got right now could definitely do with some improvement.
I was also confused as to what Meltano actually is or does... It must have taken me several minutes of roaming around the website and docs before I finally figured it out though!
I love Singer, and Meltano is the best way to run Singer! The community has been great.
When I had to develop a custom tap for a client, the support I received from the team, the SDK and the general experience was absolutely top class. Love the new site too!
